facts.value: Supplies the empty physics callback for Falcon Dive's successful catch phase, which can be entered after capturing either an airborne or grounded victim. This callback adds no physics processing; grounded-victim entry separately installs an accessory callback that copies the victim's position into Captain Falcon's position.

facts.value: Reads mv.ca.specialhi.x2_b0 to select movement processing. When set, forwards gobj to ftCa_SpecialHi_Phys, preserves self_vel.y minus mv.ca.specialhi.vel.y, passes specialhi_catch_grav and co_attrs.terminal_velocity to ftCommon_Fall, and reconstructs mv.ca.specialhi.vel.y as the resulting self_vel.y minus the saved difference. When clear, forwards gobj only to ft_80085134 and performs no direct velocity-field assignment.

facts.rationale: Separates the script-controlled terrain gate from directional reversal, includes the ledge exit, and preserves catch and successful-release exceptions.
facts.value: SpecialHi and SpecialAirHi startup animations request common special fall on completion. Their shared collision logic can instead invoke the pre-gate collision helper, enter move-specific special landing, or enter a qualifying cliff state. A nonzero command channel sets x2_b1 independently of stick magnitude; only facing and model rotation require absolute horizontal input above the move threshold. Successful capture enters SpecialHiCatch for either victim ground/air situation, then animation completion enters SpecialHiThrow. Throw completion requests ordinary Fall without an early return, while throw ground contact can enter LandingFallSpecial.

facts.value: Receives the fighter HSD_GObj, resolves its Fighter through GET_FIGHTER, and reads x221B_b7. If the bit is clear, forwards the unchanged object to ft_80083B68, whose canonical body calls ft_80082578 and discards its result. If the bit is set, this callback performs no call or mutation.
